Paul’s point is that Jews, like Gentiles, turn from God’s revelation to go their own way.
Can’t you see that his kindness is intended to turn you from your sin?
Behind Paul’s question are Jewish passages (e.g.,

) that portray a prevalent Jewish complacency toward judgment. Many Jews thought that because they were God’s people, they did not need to worry about judgment, for their sins would not be punished as the sins of Gentiles would be. Paul emphasizes that God’s grace was intended to turn the Jews from their sin, not to condone a sinful lifestyle.
